pos.personaBrief: Inter averaged 45% possession in the winning run after 61% early, and were a counter-attacking side with the most shots on the break (Serpents, Sky Sports, GFNI), though able to play a possession game.

pro.personaBrief: Vertical wing-back runs, Brozovic line-breaking passes and Lukaku shots on the break show direct, quick play, but Inter still built from the back with De Vrij, Bastoni and Eriksen.

est.personaBrief: A defined 3-5-2 with set roles and wing-backs holding the flanks, but strikers dropping to link and midfielders rotating into half-spaces (Coaches' Voice, GFNI).

lar.personaBrief: Wing-backs were the width and Cult of Calcio stresses wing-play and counters; no wingers, but crosses from varied angles by wing-backs.

blo.personaBrief: Defended in a 5-3-2 mid/low block with pressing traps on the flanks and striker pressing, Conte saying they defend high up the pitch; counters were the main weapon.

mar.personaBrief: No in-period source names a marking scheme; the shifting 5-3-2 covering flanks and half-spaces points to zonal organisation with pressing on the ball carrier.

pla.personaBrief: Conte kept the same 3-5-2 all season and said the system suits the players, adjusting in-game by moving wing-backs higher (TFA) but not abandoning his idea.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic: balance is the basis of everything, best defence, shifted back to a pragmatic strategy; Conte celebrates points and goals, not beauty.

sis.personaBrief: Conte's system with fixed roles and tactical work (Lukaku trained with his back to goal) rules; Eriksen was benched until he fit the two-phase demands.

jog.personaBrief: Powerful, intense side built on Lukaku, Barella and Hakimi engine; Eriksen was put on the market until he improved intensity.

bas.personaBrief: Title chased with veterans (Vidal, Kolarov, Young, Handanovic, De Vrij) and bought stars; no academy emphasis.

lid.personaBrief: Conte is the demanding boss who pushes players, with friction with Eriksen, rules for all, though he praises the unity of the group.
